title: Error (output, contract v2)
description: The one document an agentspace lease command writes to stderr when it fails. Its code fixes the exit code: internal 1; usage, invalid_value and out_of_range 2; not_found 3; invalid_state 4. Strict: anchored patterns end with $(?!\n), since $ alone matches before a final line feed in .NET. Each code requires and forbids its own fields. See docs/lease-api.md.

message.description: One or more sentences for a person: what was wrong, and what to do. No control characters, and not empty or starting with a space; a quoted value escapes them as \uXXXX or is left out.

field.description: The flag or request member at fault, without dashes. plan is the --plan flag or the request's plan member: invalid_value names it for a plan that is not valid, and usage for --plan given with --size, as for any other flag a usage error names. board, epic and turn are the --board, --epic and --turn flags or the request members of those names: invalid_value names each for a value that is not valid, or that names no board, card or turn, or a card whose plan cannot be used; usage names one of them for a flag given with one it excludes or without one it needs, as docs/lease-api.md, Exit codes and errors, gives each case, so --board without --epic names epic. No other code names plan, board, epic or turn.

lease_id.description: The normalized lease ID asked for: a UUIDv4 in lowercase.

state.description: The state the lease is in.
